verdict.rationale: Live probes show a Vercel-wide llms.txt (HTTP 200) and a markdown version of the Sandbox docs page at /docs/sandbox.md with structured frontmatter. A markdown changelog sitemap and a public openapi.json also exist, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable, agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt actually indexes the Sandbox docs (only its truncated header was seen, and it is platform-wide rather than Sandbox-specific), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
